title: Prescription Drug Cost Share Carried by Each Special Needs Plans Package
content:
Every plan benefit package in the Special Needs Plans category includes Part D prescription drug coverage. The deductible for the plan year and the amounts a member pays for a 30-day generic fill and a 30-day brand fill are fixed by the package.

| Plan benefit package | Part D coverage included | Part D deductible for the plan year, USD | 30-day generic fill, USD | 30-day brand fill, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Essentials (HMO D-SNP) | included | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Dual Complete Advantage (HMO D-SNP) | included | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | included | 615.00 | 6.00 | 45.00 |
| Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | included | 490.00 | 4.00 | 40.00 |
| Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) | included | 615.00 | 6.00 | 45.00 |
| Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP) | included | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

**Part D coverage included** records whether the package includes Part D prescription drug coverage. **Part D deductible** is the deductible for the plan year, in USD. The two fill columns are the member's amount for a 30-day generic fill and for a 30-day brand fill, in USD.

## Points of judgement

**Is there a package in the Special Needs Plans category without drug coverage?** There is not. All six packages include Part D prescription drug coverage.

**Which packages carry a drug deductible?** Ridgecrest Heart Care Select (HMO C-SNP) and Ridgecrest Lung Care Select (HMO C-SNP) each carry 615.00 USD, and Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP) carries 490.00 USD. The two dual eligible packages and Ridgecrest Institutional Care (HMO I-SNP) each carry 0.00 USD.

**A member of Ridgecrest Diabetes Care Select (HMO C-SNP) collects two 30-day generic fills and one 30-day brand fill.** Each generic fill is 4.00 USD and the brand fill is 40.00 USD, so the member pays 48.00 USD across the three fills.
